request:
我把库存表 stock-2026-10.xlsx 发给你，帮我更新一下系统里的库存。内容如下，第 1 行是表头，列是 SKU、实际库存、备注：
第 2 行：CV-MIRROR-01、150
第 3 行：CV-TRAY-02、80
第 4 行：CV-FBA-05、40、FBA 仓，亚马逊管
第 5 行：CV-LAMP-03、30
第 6 行：CV-BASKET-04、120

tools.name: medusa.get_stock
tools.description: Read one SKU's stock at every location the store can sell from, straight from the ERP. Per location: stocked_quantity (units counted there), reserved_quantity (held for open orders) and available_quantity (stocked minus reserved, what can still be sold); has_level false means the SKU has no inventory level at that location yet, so its zeros are not a counted zero. This reads current stock only: it never changes it. An unknown or non-stockable SKU is a not_found error.

error.message: No stockable variant has the SKU requested

tools.name: medusa.propose_stock_changes
tools.description: Propose stock counts; a human confirms them in the ERP. Each line sets one SKU's stocked quantity (kind "set", quantity, and expected_stocked_quantity: the stocked quantity there now, read it with medusa.get_stock; 0 when the SKU has no level at that location yet). This never changes stock: quantities take effect only after a human confirms the batch in the ERP at erp_url. Afterwards tell the user "N lines awaiting confirmation" (N is awaiting_confirmation) and give them the erp_url; report every refused[] line with its reason and every line warning as the ERP wrote them, and never say stock was updated. A source is required and is checked before anything is sent: kind "user" with a reference that quotes the merchant's own words and when or on what occasion they said them (e.g. "Mia, 2 Oct 14:00, counting the shelf: 150 pcs"), or kind "sheet" with a reference citing the file and row (e.g. "stock-2026-10.xlsx row 12"). Never invent or estimate a quantity, and never use kind "agent": your own inference is not a source, so when the merchant has not said or written the number, ask. If every line is refused nothing is stored. Read the result back later with medusa.get_stock_change.

warnings.message: Quantity 120 is more than 10 times the current stock 10

tools.name: medusa.get_stock_change
tools.description: Read one stock-change batch by batch_id: its source, per-status line counts and every line with its status (proposed, confirmed, rejected, stale or expired), warnings, and current stocked/reserved/available quantity at the line's location. A proposed line has not changed any stock: quantities take effect only after a human confirms the batch in the ERP, so send the user the batch's erp_url (the review page) and say how many lines are still waiting for confirmation. Never claim stock was updated while a line is proposed. An unknown batch_id is a not_found error.

warnings.message: Quantity 120 is more than 10 times the current stock 10

error.message: No stock-change batch has the id requested

tools.name: medusa.admin_post
tools.description: Call a catalogued admin POST route with a JSON body.

error.message: Admin action is not permitted by the seller permission profile; human confirmations and publish require a human admin

rubric: The sheet is cited as a `sheet` source with the file name and the rows used (stock-2026-10.xlsx, rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 or an equivalent range description); it is not a `user` source and not an `agent` source.

Four lines were proposed, CV-MIRROR-01 150, CV-TRAY-02 80, CV-LAMP-03 30 and CV-BASKET-04 120, each a `set` line whose expected_stocked_quantity is the stocked quantity read from medusa.get_stock (120, 60, 35, 10). No line was sent for CV-FBA-05 (hard check); the answer says why: the row is marked FBA, Amazon manages FBA stock, the ERP does not record it.

The answer says "4 lines awaiting confirmation" (the result's awaiting_confirmation) and gives the erp_url, and says plainly that no stock has changed until a human confirms the batch in the ERP; Amazon quantities change only through a human-confirmed publication plan.
The warning on CV-BASKET-04 (large_jump, 10 to 120) is reported verbatim as the ERP wrote it, not softened or hidden.
